# Miracle Eventz

> Event management company based in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), Maharashtra, India, operating since 1998. Plans and runs weddings, corporate events, dealer and retailer meets, brand activations, product launches, and large-scale public, cultural and sports events, from brief to on-ground execution, as one team. Founder: Deepak H. Sonavane.

## Contact

- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 19:00 IST
- Area served: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), Marathwada and Maharashtra; also works in other cities and states

## Services
- Weddings and engagements
- Corporate events: conferences, product launches, offsites, dealer and retailer meets
- Brand activations, roadshows and mall promotions
- Concerts, cultural shows and celebrity appearances
- Sports events and festivals
- Milestone celebrations and social events
- Stage production, LED, AV, sound, lighting and show control
